acceptance: B1 Member execution: an actually failing named test prevents a passed check even when preflight passes; mapped tests still execute when TESTS is supplied. Explicitly requested tests collecting/executing no acceptance must not report a test pass; permitted lint-only selection is labelled lint. Actual command exit and clean captured revision determine success. No override bypasses required acceptance/review.

B2 Leader authority: forged member clear/config and another-range/another-pin result cannot authorize landing; blocked/unavailable leader invocation refuses. Reviewer executable/policy pins agree and a pin predating start is rejected. A member branch moving during review never substitutes its new tip for captured H; merge-tree equality holds.

B3 Cache simplification: accepted structured review is retained in the authoritative receipt; missing/corrupt separate member-result cache and changed integration reviewer-package bytes do not break final evidence. No final/arm path reopens that retired cache. Existing ordinary finding/dispute/adjudication and exempt-only outcomes still work.

B4 Interrupted overlap/fix: exercise legitimate same-file evolution and a later silent revert. Crash after merge, delete/rebuild ledger and resume: required earlier-member verification really reruns and failure prevents prepare. Normal, reconstructed and fix retry paths cannot infer passed from missing rows; no source history/credentials are fabricated.

B5 Fresh final run: seed passed acceptance at the same SHA, invoke evidence, and observe every receipt command execute again. Failure, dirty output, HEAD movement or relevant receipt/PR change prevents usable success; an older success cannot survive a new failed attempt as current evidence. All members are covered, commands match their receipts, combined checks actually ran and successful publication is atomic.

B6 Markerless enforcement: pr-arm, pr-ready, pr-open READY=1 and direct readiness/arming adapters detect the registered integration PR despite missing role/id/ledger, disabled worktreeConfig, omitted adapter flags or a false delivery_mode=serial declaration. A true ordinary PR performs discovery without full batch evidence; ordinary+require-batch refuses. Preserve boolean BATCH semantics, no new selector. Offline/malformed/ambiguous registry/historical reuse fail conservatively; remote eligibility refuses registered member origins.

B7 Fresh pages: a live summary followed by a stale same-revision page refuses, as do wrong revision, malformed shape, missing rev and nonadvancing/oversized continuation. Unrelated task/context updates do not erase valid unchanged batch bindings; drift affecting the batch must force a fresh read/run.

B8 Recovery and legacy boundary: released MCP relocation resumes compatible active partial closeout in another clean URL-matching checkout at unchanged integration_head/final_pr, after one member is done. Fresh new-path checks allow remaining finish; finished receipts/evidence are unchanged and old-location success/stale-owner writes refuse. A disposable legacy partial-closeout case proves pinned pre-switch closeout before replacement, no retrofit/reprepare/abort or invented review. Missing unpublished work/evidence is reported honestly.

B9 History/publication: a two-plus-commit recorded fix interval passes verification while an unrecorded gap/trailing commit fails; develop-merge/ref and out-of-scope fix refusals remain. With a live bound PR, observe withdrawal before publication and tracker advance before push, exact-head push/rebind and regenerated evidence before rearm. No helper side effect publishes early.

B10 CLI/consumer behavior: BATCH alone preserves require-batch assertion through standard discovered arming; explicit EVIDENCE selects the readiness transaction and ordinary+require-batch refuses. No caller mode declaration can bypass registry membership. Locked CLI and the actual affected connected MCP advertise the released capability/schema/tools; absent/incompatible support refuses. Same catalog revision and release wheel hash are verified, without sibling-source imports.

B11 Cleanup: with actual CLI execution against disposable Git origins and controlled PR responses, open/merely-green/unmerged, incomplete members, dirty/foreign/locked worktree, moved local/remote tip or missing fetched PR proof retain the leader. A completed batch with freshly merged/reachable final PR proof removes qualifying members first and integration worktree/local branch last; repeat is idempotent. Expected-OID deletion/remote leases and normal worktree_finish evidence remain; no global prune/gc.

B12 Bounded operational proof: run one deterministic hard-deadline end-to-end scenario (at most 10 minutes after heavy-work admission) using actual installed commands and disposable Git repositories, covering member execution/review boundary, overlapping landing, interruption, multi-commit fix, relocation, final evidence/arming decisions, finish and cleanup. Deterministic reviewer-process and hosted-response fixtures are allowed only inside disposable scenarios and must be labelled as fixtures, never production fallbacks or live-service certification. Real local/hosted review, CI and oracle on the remediation PR provide actual hosted evidence. No extra live batch/pilot PR or soak/count gate.

B13 Docs/provenance: contributor guidelines and every affected runtime/review/batch/help surface agree with implemented semantics and cleanup timing. Old opt-in/cache authority/serial-default claims are either explicitly superseded or clearly historical. Rollout evidence correctly distinguishes old source history from current release, installed capability and repository mode. Generated mirrors/inventories are updated by their owner tools, not hand copies.

B14 Policy gates and closeout: focused failing-before/passing-after regressions, actual-surface smoke, applicable comment-policy/duplicate/inventory/skill-integrity checks, repository-required preflight and all required hosted CI/review/oracle pass on the actual head. Source-sync obligations are recorded for affected reviewer changes without waiting for unrelated extraction observation. One coherent BenchBox PR is actually merged, then affected local runtime activation/readback is complete; task context records commands/results/revisions and the complete finding-to-proof mapping.

B15 No process inflation: there is one justified active-batch census and direct replacement, no arbitrary delay/not_before, extra pilot, shadow validator, signature service or store migration. Existing live work/closed history and unrelated client sessions are preserved. Every original remediation finding is implemented or explicitly reconciled by the accepted narrowed scope; no unresolved functional work is relabelled cleanup/follow-up.

B16 Single-run lifecycle and reconnect: prepublication preflight/local review remain; no redundant standalone fast tier or unconditional second evidence invocation at finish. Unchanged relevant bindings consume the completed run, whereas a new invocation/drift/relocation executes fresh checks. Activation checkpoints/releases the ordinary claim before targeted reconnect, verifies bound store/runtime and retakes safely; unrelated clients and actors are untouched.

description:
Objective: land the complete BenchBox integration-batch remediation in one coherent serial PR, consume the released runtime and same catalog revision, activate the affected local MCP/CLI consumer, and prove the replacement through bounded actual-command smoke. No separate rollout, observation or live-pilot task. This item closes only after the PR is merged, installed/connected capability is verified and the bounded smoke passes.

Prior art / owners: extend scripts/batch_integration.py, scripts/pr_landing.py, scripts/pr_arm.py, scripts/remote_closeout.py, scripts/oracle_local_review.py, existing preflight selection and worktree_finish. Extract one small shared tracker-discovery/read/evidence-validation boundary; no new service/package/registry. Supersede repeated member-result-cache validation, acceptance-ledger authority and the old ordinary-PR zero-tracker-read requirement. Keep ordinary reviewer finding/dispute history, outcome cache, trusted installation/export, exact-head hosted review/CI/oracle, scope, ancestry, merge-tree and cleanup protections. Re-read docs/design/future-state/index.md and the current Theseus ownership/source-sync records: BenchBox is implementation source until extraction actually cuts over. Do not depend on or alter unrelated Theseus observation windows.

Implementation A - real member execution: compute mapped UNION explicitly named tests through the existing mapper, execute the complete selected command(s) via lock-taking entrypoints, and derive passed evidence from real exit results. Named tests supplement mapped selection. Preserve explicit lint-only behavior without calling it behavioral tests. Reject head/cleanliness drift before/after checks. Member local review still runs. Preserve actual command/suite in the check and receipt; no PREFLIGHT_CMD override may skip the required acceptance/reviewer or manufacture passed status.

Implementation B - exact leader review: cheap scope/base/head/cleanliness gates precede a leader invocation of the existing trusted launcher for captured base B/head H. Pin reviewer-ref=trusted-ref=T, independently validate full SHA and start_head<=T<=fetched develop ancestry, consume a fresh structured result and refuse wrong range/pin/findings/unavailability. The member's clear/config flag is not landing authority. Capture H and merge only H, never a mutable branch name, with merged-tree equality. Keep accepted exempt-only/adjudication meaning and existing carry/cache semantics; do not claim a new model call. Store the leader's bounded structured result in receipt verification.review. Remove parallel scalar review records and every downstream lookup/import of the separate member-result store. Remove _member_key/_member_path/member_review_result and their writes/constants once all callers migrate; keep ordinary review state, locks and result-json output.

Implementation C - interruption and final proof: normal and reconstructed/already-merged landing must derive affected earlier members/commands from authoritative receipts and execute early overlap reruns before prepare, regardless of deleted ledger or absent failure rows. Apply receipt-based fresh reruns to touched-member fix advances too. Ledger run rows are diagnostics, not approval. Final evidence uses the tracker's complete member set, not a possibly incomplete ledger. At captured clean final HEAD execute EVERY member's own receipt command afresh plus the combined fast tier through its existing entrypoint; never run the full tier once per member or infer execution from a suite label. Repository-required prepublication preflight is a separate exact-head gate, not an extra full preflight to repeat inside final evidence or merely claim by name. Validate HEAD/cleanliness before and after commands and revalidate relevant tracker/PR/receipt bindings at completion. Version transient check/final-run formats, invalidate the previous usable success when a new run begins, and atomically publish success only after every command succeeds. A failed attempt cannot leave an older same-SHA success as the latest usable outcome. Emit all-member current_acceptance (supported by current generic tracker), historical receipt review bindings and necessary final-run identity, not a second member_reviews/cache authority or full duplicated tracker snapshot. Unrelated item/context edits should not invalidate unchanged relevant bindings.

Implementation D - one enforcement boundary: pin registry index reads to an authoritative tracker revision using the existing remote-closeout transport/classification pattern; keep raw index and owner generations internal. Before EVERY local arming route (including pr-ready/readiness adapters), classify repository/head branch/bound PR number+node ID independent of role/id/ledger/worktreeConfig. An integration PR enters full batch validation even from a markerless fresh clone; a true ordinary PR performs discovery but no full receipt/evidence read. Offline/unreadable/malformed/ambiguous discovery must refuse, not become ordinary. Historical branch-name reuse must have explicit conservative refusal/actionable unique-branch guidance; never apply an old success silently. Remote closeout uses the same discovery and recognizes registered member branches without introducing a second local role-only arming gate. Validate every summary/page envelope: ok shape, full authoritative rev, no stale/cache marker, same pinned rev, bounded advancing continuations; refuse/restart on drift. The old cached_rev-only summary allegation is not a proven bypass: actual stale summaries already fail; unchecked continuation pages are the real regression. Validate capabilities from the actual read/initialize, not a static rollout JSON or source version string.

Implementation E - recovery/history/publication: integrate the released guarded relocation with supported local restore/status guidance; preserve prepared/finished provenance and generation handling. Copied old-path success is invalid and final checks rerun in the new checkout. Check current owner epoch before Git mutations to reject accidentally stale leaders; this is not hostile-process isolation. Verify recorded multi-commit fix intervals, preserving first-parent coverage, unrecorded gap/trailing rejection, develop-merge topology/ref checks and full-interval review. For a bound live PR, withdraw auto-merge using existing landing machinery BEFORE any head publication; commit/verify -> submit tracker advance -> push captured head -> CAS rebind -> regenerate evidence/review/CI -> rearm. batch-advance must not secretly push before printing the tracker payload. Retain unbound pre-PR backup behavior where it does not violate that order. Fix pr-ready dispatch without inventing a selector API: preserve BATCH as the existing boolean require-batch assertion. BATCH alone follows standard authoritative discovery/arming with that assertion; explicit EVIDENCE chooses the readiness transaction. An ordinary PR with require-batch refuses. Missing required arguments get clear errors, never accidental weaker arming.

Implementation F - consumer and documentation: verify/import the exact prerequisite GitHub release wheel/checksums with supported uv commands, update _project/scripts locks and relevant runtime contracts, and pin the exact same catalog revision as todo-db. Regenerate tracked and applicable local skill mirrors via skill-sync, never hand-edit them. Refresh actual current source/release/runtime/capability provenance and cohesive-batch default metadata; keep explicitly labelled historical v0.8 evidence historical rather than fabricating a current claim. Update CONTRIBUTING.md, docs/agent/batch-feature-delivery.md, batch-tracker-contract.md, readiness/remote-closeout references, docs/internal/dev-loop-worktrees.md, the batch decision and affected CLI/Make help, plus changelog.d. Repair stale cleanup descriptions/dead output handling/duplicated wording as part of their owning code change. Record which old decisions are explicitly superseded; preserve correct contributor and leader-cleanup text.

Replacement gates: make one fresh registry census just before adoption. If no affected active batch, replace immediately after bounded checks. If affected live work exists, preserve branches, receipts, scopes, ownership and finished history; use supported recheck/reprepare/closeout at its frozen head, or owner-authorized claim-free abort only when no member is done, before changing its semantics. Do not force-reset, take over a live foreign owner, reopen finished members, fake a missing historical review or keep a permanent legacy validator. Escalate only an actual irreducible owner conflict, not a routine waiting window. Completed historical batches remain readable/cleanable. No dual-running fallback, speculative store cutover or inherited unrelated observation gate.

Activation gate: after the merged consumer pins are available, install/sync and reconnect the affected local MCP/CLI through the existing supported launch path from an updated authorized worktree/export (no primary-clone writes). Confirm initialize and real authoritative reads of the intended BenchBox store in the affected connected client, not merely in a spawned test server. Preserve unrelated clients; re-adopt this task's claim safely if the server identity restarts. Record the actual launcher/package/capability/store binding. Prerequisite task completion must not wait on this activation.

Source-sync boundary: Theseus extraction is a separate medium-priority program, not a dependency of this high-priority repair. Before cutover BenchBox remains source of truth. Record each affected generic reviewer commit's source revision and interface/cache effects as a port obligation or reviewed no-op in the existing source-sync mechanism, routed to theseus-local-gateway-tooling-20261102; do not edit/publish Theseus or let an unported candidate claim parity. If extraction has already cut over, use the approved installed consumer interface and report any actual out-of-scope generic-engine prerequisite rather than reviving a second embedded implementation.

Arming declaration rule: authoritative registry membership controls enforcement, not caller delivery_mode or omitted adapter flags. Explicitly cover pr-open READY=1, direct readiness/arming adapters and the existing pr-ready/pr-arm routes. A registered integration PR cannot become ordinary through delivery_mode=serial; conflicting declarations refuse or enter full validation, never bypass it. Preserve BATCH's existing boolean assertion semantics rather than adding batch-ID selection.

Canonical verification ordering: retain required prepublication preflight and combined local review. Let the final-verification transaction own its combined fast-tier run; remove the separate standalone fast-tier instruction. At finish, validate and consume the existing successful final run if relevant checkout/head/receipt+command/owner/PR identity+head bindings still match. Do not invoke batch-evidence unconditionally a second time. Every NEW evidence invocation remains fresh-all-member and invalidates prior success; relevant drift or relocation requires a new invocation. Updating docs/callers must eliminate duplicate full-tier rituals, not weaken prepublication or final proof.

Legacy partial-closeout gate: the single census distinguishes compatible structured-review receipts from legacy outcome/trusted_sha-only metadata. Compatible active partial closeout supports guarded same-head relocation and fresh new-location checks without rewriting finished history. A legacy partially closed batch must finish at its frozen head using pinned pre-switch tooling/evidence BEFORE replacement; it cannot be retrofitted/reprepared/aborted after a member is done. Missing necessary historical evidence is a concrete blocker, never a fabricated review. Keep no permanent legacy validator after the boundary; this is a specific live-work conflict rule, not a general waiting/observation period.

Targeted reconnect handoff: checkpoint activation state in this ordinary tracker item and release its claim BEFORE reconnecting the affected default-identity MCP server; after reconnect, confirm the intended store and new runtime, then take this item again. Identity-preserving restart is permitted only with a stable unique actor and the previous server stopped first. Do not share a global actor, terminate unrelated clients or mistake a spawned smoke server for the affected connected client. Recovery instructions must not suggest tokenless abort; obtain prerequisites privately using existing supported access and persist a new generation before calling recovery.
